module.name: Mode Layer
module.purpose: Governs the interaction stance within an RTT/1 session — defines how the system engages (posture), not what it processes (payload). Orthogonal to content, regime, and substrate.

modules_linked: rtt-core → modes → transitions → regimes → operators → propagation
